context: Hiroshi and Kenji handle organizational change.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 健次、組織変更、説明する。
lines.en: Kenji — we're merging two departments. I need to explain the changes.
lines.style: Measured announcement. Open clearly on the name. Even tempo, no rush. The weight of authority undercuts any harshness — this is simply fact. Steady gaze. Brief pause before the details.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Yes, understood. I'm ready to listen.
lines.style: Quiet respect without stiffness. Slight forward lean in posture. Warm receptiveness threaded beneath the formality. Genuine readiness — not performing attentiveness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: We're consolidating two departments into one.
lines.style: Clear, methodical. Light emphasis on 'two' and 'one' — marking the concrete change. Pace remains unhurried. The composure of someone who has already thought this through completely.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: We'll need to prepare contingencies, won't we.
lines.style: Thoughtful but not hesitant. Not a question — a quiet acknowledgment of what comes next. Warm tone underneath the professional framing. Leaning into the shared problem-solving.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Slight shift toward inclusion. The word 'together' lands softly but lands. Even pace continues. The offer of collaboration — not delegation. Steady confidence that this can be done.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 責任、全力で、果たします。
lines.en: I'll give this everything I have.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. The strength is in the simplicity, not the volume. Eyes steady. No performance — just a man stating what he will do. Respect woven through, directed back at the moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Brief, final. Warm undertone — this is trust being placed, not an order being issued. The kind word that lands because it's earned, not given lightly. Brief pause after, letting it settle.
